title: Evolved Exploration PLUS
description: Evolved Exploration PLUS modpack is new updated version of Evolved Exploration modpack (found in CurseForge).
body:
Evolved Exploration PLUS modpack is made adventuring in mind.

• Terralith and Dynamic Surroundings mods to overhaul the adventuring experience.

• Iris Shaders to allow use of shaders and 4 pre-installed shaderpacks.

• Bunch of performance boosting mods like Sodium, Lithium, Nvidium and others.

• Detail Armor Bar and Immersive UI.

• Farmer's Delight Refacbricated included for adventuring and also farming in mind.

• New armor and also tool trims.

• Xaero's Minimap, Xaero's World Map and Just Enough Items mods.

I hope you have good moments with this modpack! :)
